reviews.title: excellent value for the price and solid specs
reviews.comment:
I’m very satisfied with this motherboard, it offers excellent value for the price and solid specs. I’m currently running it with an Ultra 7 265K, and it performs flawlessly. My only minor complaint is that it didn’t include a detailed manual with clear instructions; I had to rely on the website for setup guidance. It would also be nice if it came with some promotional materials like other brands do.
Overall, though, this is a great choice for anyone looking for a budget-friendly motherboard that still delivers strong performance and reliability. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Alejandro Moisa

reviews.title: GPU PCiE slots malfunctioning and can't even return it...
reviews.comment: I was building a PC by buying parts slowly over time. Finally got everything and finished putting everything together and unfortunately, there was some sort of problem with the reinforced gpu slot on the board. I tried multiple cards, monitors and cables and no video. Computer tries to post but stuck on VGA on the board led lights and can't get any video to even check the BiOs to see if there is some other issue I can fix through that. Tried to use the other lower PCiE slots to troubleshoot but with their position, my 2 cards couldn't fit if I wanted to get them in to try... and now I am outside my return window so I am stuck with it...
reviews.author: Al Sava

reviews.title: Check the memory support list first
reviews.comment: Great quality board. Complete feature set you would expect. Memory support is somewhat lacking compared to AM5 boards. None of the kits I had on hand were on the QVL list, and only one actually allowed the system to boot. However, every BIOS update seems to be including improved memory compatabilty, so hopefully that won't be too much of an issue moving forward.
reviews.author: Maestro2442
